description: This Java class `AIMRespPositions` defines response positions for the Authorize.Net AIM v3.1 API, mapping response field names to their positional indices in the response string, and provides methods to retrieve position indices and an approval code string.

classes.name: AIMRespPositions
classes.description: Defines positional indices for various Response fields from the Authorize.Net AIM v3.1 response.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the index position of the specified response field name; returns -1 if not found.

methods.name: getApprovalString
methods.description: Returns the string '1', representing an approval code.
